messages:
maria.g: incident-bot triggered for tenant BeaconPay, paging on 5xx rate > 2% for 5m. Seeing repeated pages and duplicates across shifts.
incident-bot: [Pager] 5xx_rate_high - tenant:BeaconPay - 5xx_rate=2.4% - triggered at 2026-03-10T15:20:10Z :rotating_light:
devin: I'm on it. pulling logs and metrics.
cam_r: quick note — this tenant has a known traffic pattern during batch jobs at 15:00 UTC, may be expected. Can we confirm traffic spike?
leo: @devin here's a link to the pods: `kubectl get pods -n serving | grep beaconpay` — noticing restarts on worker-nodes-2.
samir_k: can we mute the noisy tenant-specific check and switch to watchlist instead? This is causing noisy pages for oncall.
maria.g: agree. if impact is limited to a tenant and within SLA window, prefer watchlist. Can someone run a quick impact query (errors by tenant last 10m)?
devin: running prom query:
```
sum(rate(http_requests_total{tenant="BeaconPay",status=~"5.."}[5m])) / sum(rate(http_requests_total{tenant="BeaconPay"}[5m])) * 100
```
=> 5xx_rate ~2.3% across 5m, spike corresponds to job-worker restarts.
cam_r: logs show backend worker OOMs around 15:18, 15:21. Stacktrace attached in thread.
maria.g: OK let's mute the pager for 1h and add tenant to watchlist. @ops-bot can you silence the alert rule `tenant:5xx_rate_high` for tenant BeaconPay for 60m?
ops-bot: Command acknowledged. Silencing `tenant:5xx_rate_high` for BeaconPay for 60m. Reason: investigating OOM restarts. :white_check_mark:
samir_k: while muted, let's create a temporary metric dashboard and add rolling windows and raw counts. I'll spin up a graf panel.
leo: also propose raising threshold to 3% for tenant-specific rule and add a QoS window to avoid paging on short bursts. We should treat global slas different from tenant ones.
maria.g: agreed. After incident, we'll do a threshold sweep across top 20 tenants and add a 'burst suppression' buffer. Devin, can you capture the exact signal so product can decide if SLA was actually hit?
devin: capturing exports and will attach csv. Early look: no customer-reported errors, internal retries succeeded. Product impact seems unlikely but we'll document.
cam_r: created dashboard panel: https://grafana.company/g/abcd BeaconPay errors by worker and pod. Sharing snapshots.
maria.g: handover to @cam_r for post-incident follow-up and remediation. I'll mark incident as 'investigating -> watchlist' and update runbook.
cam_r: taking the follow-up. Action items: 1) primary: increase pod memory for batch workers, 2) tune alert threshold + burst suppression, 3) schedule a 2-hour postmortem if SLA breach confirmed.
samir_k: will open a PR for alert config update. Proposed change:
```
alert: tenant:5xx_rate_high
expr: increase(rate(http_requests_total{status=~"5..",tenant="{{tenant}}"}[5m])[5m]) > 0.03
for: 10m
annotations: 
  runbook: /runbooks/tenant-5xx
```
maria.g: thanks. Also add a check to avoid pages during scheduled tenant batch window (15:00-15:30 UTC) — add an exemption label.
incident-bot: Incident status changed: muted -> watchlisted. No page in last 30m. :information_source:
maria.g: closing handoff. last check in 30m and we'll revert silence if healthy. :thumbsup:
devin: uploaded logs and CSV at https://s3.company/si/beaconpay-ooms.csv
cam_r: PR opened for alert change: https://git.company/repo/alerts/pull/312
samir_k: +1 on merging after 24h of no regression.
leo: adding to monitoring backlog: MON-4276 'tenant alert burst suppression and per-tenant thresholds'
maria.g: thanks team, good coordination. If product reports any customer-visible issue, re-open the page.
ops-bot: Reminder: did you want to create an SLA incident record? Use `/create-incident` — include tenant tag.
maria.g: yes, creating incident record now and tagging with BeaconPay and followups.
